about_me_txt:
I’m Harpreet Singh, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant with IRB authorization, which enables me to represent clients before the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, including in complex appeals such as spousal sponsorship or residency obligation breaches.

As a first-generation immigrant, I understand firsthand the uncertainty, urgency, and hope tied to every immigration decision. That’s why I founded MGG Immigration & Refugee Services Inc. ➤ to empower people with not just the right paperwork, but the right awareness, tools, and strategies to make informed, confident choices about their future in Canada. Before entering this field, I practiced as a dentist and later got a Master’s in Health and Human Services Management from Australia, where I also worked for over three years in the immigration sector. My background in healthcare strengthens my ability to support clients facing complex issues like medical inadmissibility, an area where both compassion and legal clarity are critical.

I’ve invested significant time immersed in the world of IAD appeals, particularly those involving spousal sponsorship and residency obligation. After witnessing dozens of these hearings, I’ve learned that preparation isn’t about the quantity of documents; It’s about building a truthful narrative that addresses and closes evidentiary gaps . That’s the mindset I bring to every case I take on. Whether you're facing a sponsorship refusal or navigating your first study permit, I work to simplify the process, explain every step in plain language, and respond quickly, something my clients frequently appreciate.

Beyond consultations, I’m committed to community education and actively developing free public info sessions and a newsletter to help newcomers understand their rights and avoid misinformation or exploitation.

When I’m not consulting, you’ll likely find me at the gym or deep in a good book (my favourite is Who Moved My Cheese? — a reminder that adaptability is everything, especially in immigration).

Let's Connect
When you’re ready, I’m here to represent you confidently and transparently. You can:
➤ My website (www.mggimmigration.com)
➤ Book a personalised consultation (https://www.mggimmigration.com/#contact)
➤ Read my upcoming articles

Let me help you turn uncertainty into a clear, confident immigration plan — with integrity, clarity, and care.

about_me_txt:
I am Dr. Andrei Zavialov, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB), R1034357 ( verify status ) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (the body which regulates the profession of Immigration Consultants in Canada) and a CEO of Rosebay Canada Immigration Services.
Immigration is my passion. I am deeply involved in immigration matters from different perspectives, including immigration policies and social adaptation of immigrants. I hold a PhD in Sociology related to interaction between immigrants and host societies, and policy involvement.
I am an alumnus of Queen's University Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law , one of two immigration and citizenship law programs in Canada which prepare immigration consultants of a new generation.
I am a strong supporter of information transparency, accuracy, and professional ethics. Inclusion, diversity, equity and accessibility inform my style of work. I provide services in English, Ukrainian, Russian, and French. Smooth immigration journey for my clients is what I am keen to.
I offer a wide variety of immigration services, including temporary entry (visas, work and study permits), permanent residence (economic and family immigration), citizenship, as well as many other immigration services, and I will be happy to assist you in your immigration journey!

about_me_txt:
I am Narek Mirzoyan, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants and the founder of Mirzoyan Canadian Immigration Services Inc. in Toronto. After more than six years of experience in legal support and immigration work at Deloitte, and national notary‑network management at NotaryPro, I turned my full focus to guiding newcomers through Canada’s complex immigration landscape.

Immigration is more than a profession for me—it is a lifelong commitment to helping people find their place in a new country. My background spans hands‑on client representation, policy research, and product‑operations work that sharpened my eye for compliance and process efficiency. That same experience drives me to make each application strategy clear, accurate, and tailored to clients’ real‑world goals.

Transparency, professional ethics, and a firm belief in inclusion, diversity, equity, and accessibility shape everything I do. I serve clients in English, Armenian, and Russian , ensuring cultural nuances are respected and every voice is heard. Whether someone needs a visitor visa, study or work permit, permanent residence pathway, or citizenship application, I aim to provide a smooth, stress‑free journey marked by honest advice and meticulous preparation.

If you’re ready to build your future in Canada, I would be honored to accompany you every step of the way.

about_me_txt:
Sid Rahman (legal name: Md Siddiqur Rahman) is a seasoned professional with over 15 years of diverse experience spanning immigration consultancy, telecommunication engineering, business development, and project management. As a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), Sid has established himself as a proficient Corporate Immigration Consultant specializing in Canadian immigration services.

With a career in the Canadian immigration industry since 2018, Sid has built a strong reputation for his expertise in various immigration pathways. He specializes in immigration services, with extensive expertise in study permits, open work permits, visitor visas, super visas, business visitor visas, the Start-up Visa program, family sponsorship, and permanent residency pathways. He has a particular focus on Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), offering in-depth knowledge and guidance on the various immigration streams and opportunities available to applicants.

Before transitioning to immigration consulting, Sid accumulated over a decade of experience in the IT and Telecommunications sectors, working with globally recognized vendors. During this time, he held a variety of roles, including Engineering, Business Development, and Project Management, further honing his expertise and leadership skills. This experience has equipped him with a unique skill set that blends technical, business, and immigration expertise, enabling him to provide tailored solutions to clients from diverse backgrounds.

Sid holds a post-graduate degree in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, where he has contributed as a volunteer mentor since 2022, assisting new students in navigating the program. He has also been involved in project work as a casual administrator and has delivered speaking engagements at events hosted by the university. Additionally, Sid holds dual Master’s degrees in Telecommunication Engineering and Business Administration, along with globally recognized certifications such as Google Analytics for Beginners, ITIL® Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management, and PRINCE2® Foundation Certificate in Project Management.

Sid’s blend of academic credentials, professional certifications, and practical experience positions him as a valuable resource for businesses and clients, particularly those with hybrid backgrounds, seeking expert guidance in navigating the complexities of Canadian immigration.

about_me_txt:
Tomi is a dedicated and highly skilled Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) with a passion for supporting immigrants and international students in achieving their goals. She holds a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University in Kingston, Ontario. Additionally, Tomi brings a global perspective to her work, with a Master’s in Marketing Communication from the University of Huddersfield, UK, and a Postgraduate Certificate in Digital Marketing from Rome Business School, Italy.
With over a decade of experience in international student recruitment, Tomi has held impactful roles within the UK and Canada's higher education sectors. As a former international student herself, she understands the complexities of navigating immigration policies and is committed to making the process seamless for her clients.
When she’s not helping others on their immigration journey, Tomi enjoys exploring new destinations, perfecting her baking skills, and spending quality time with family and friends.

about_me_txt:
I am Mona Bakhtiari, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) holding a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen's University. My journey in the immigration field has been characterized by an unwavering commitment to my clients. My profound understanding of immigration regulations and laws equips me to navigate the complexities of the Canadian immigration system effectively. My academic foundation empowers me to provide clients with the guidance they need. In addition to my legal expertise, I bring a diverse background as an ESL Teacher and Educator, enhancing my practice with a wealth of empathy and cultural understanding. This unique perspective allows me to connect with clients from various backgrounds, making their immigration journey smoother and more reassuring.

My passion lies in helping clients achieve their goals, whether it's obtaining visas, study permits, permanent residency, or citizenship. I ensure personalized support and clarity for each client, resulting in a seamless transition to their new life in Canada. Furthermore, I hold a Master's degree in Cell and Molecular Biology from Iran and Germany, along with a Bachelor's degree in Language Interpretation and Translation from Iran. I am fluent in both English and Farsi (Persian). My academic achievements and language proficiency contribute to my ability to serve clients effectively and comprehensively.

about_me_txt:
Nodira is a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant – IRB and a Commissioner for Oaths in and for the Province of Alberta. Born and raised in Tajikistan, Nodira obtained her Law degree at the Tajik State University of Law, Business, & Politics in 1999. By 2002 Nodira immigrated to Canada along with her family, where later in 2008, she completed the Professional Legal Assistant program at CDI College in Calgary, Alberta. In 2022, Nodira obtained a Graduate Diploma from the Immigration and Citizenship Law program at Queen’s University.

Prior to becoming an immigration consultant; Nodira first worked at a boutique law firm, where she specialized in residential real estate transactions. From 2013 onward, she worked for one of the top litigation law firms in Calgary where she developed a wide range of skills specializing in research, document preparation and management.
During her study in the GDipICL program at Queen’s University, Nodira gained the required knowledge and professional skills needed for working in the immigration law field. She has a deep understanding of Canadian immigration and citizenship law and procedures, as well as the knowledge and skills necessary for successful practice.
With her extensive experience in the legal industry, you can trust Nodira with your immigration journey to Canada.

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education:
Born and raised in Punjab, India, I developed a fascination with global cultures and a passion for helping individuals navigate the complexities of immigration. I pursued undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Masters in Physics at the Punjabi University, Patiala, India. Eager to gain practical experience in the area of immigration law, I worked as a junior consultant at a reputable immigration firm.

Entry into Immigration Law:
I always had a desire to make a meaningful impact on people's lives which led me to pursue a career in immigration law. I completed a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen's University, Kingston, obtaining a solid foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures.

Becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant:
Recognizing the importance of professional accreditation, I set my sights on becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) under the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). With my commitment to ethical practices and dedication to client success, I earned my license as an RCIC.

Founding Planned Immigration Inc:
Armed with my RCIC license and a vision for a client-centric consultancy, I founded Planned Immigration Inc. I promise personalized approach and commitment to guiding clients through the intricate immigration process. I specialize in various immigration streams, including Express Entry, family reunification with family/spousal sponsorship, Study Permit, Work Permit, AAIP, Visitor Visa, Super Visa, and provincial nominee programs.

Professional Development and Continuous Learning:
Understanding the dynamic nature of immigration policies, I prioritize ongoing professional development. I attend conferences, workshops, and training sessions to stay abreast of regulatory changes and emerging trends so that I can offer clients the most up-to-date and accurate advice.

about_me_txt:
My background is in marketing. I worked in the wine industry for more than 15 years as a marketer, brand manager, and salesperson. I found that working as a marketer exciting because it requires innovation and enthusiasm. Unlike mathematics, marketing tasks are never-ending and continuously evolving.
During time as a wine salesperson and team manager, I was happy to interact with people, discussing wines and helping clients to find what they desired to consume
I spent a total of 17 years in Korea as a wine enthusiast before deciding to become an RCIC.
The journey was not easy to be a RCIC however,I finally reached my goal. Nevertheless, my journey is not yet complete.
Currently, I work as an RCIC and Daycare Consultant in British Columbia.
Both jobs allow me to engage with people, enhance my work, listen well, and provide comprehensive plans.
I believe that opening a daycare and moving to Canada share commonalities because the process to reach the goal should be both fast and thorough.
My goal is to provide a well-structured plan for the client, encompassing not just the immediate future but the entire journey.

about_me_txt:
As a passionate advocate at the nexus of immigration and education, I have dedicated my career to empowering individuals through comprehensive guidance on their journey to Canadian immigration and academic excellence.

My role as an Adjunct Professor at Queen's University, where I teach Ethics to future immigration consultants, showcases my commitment to upholding and imparting the highest professional standards.

My extensive experience in helping more than 1500 RCICs to pass their CICC Entry to Practice Exam further highlights my dedication to transforming intricate immigration laws into practical, accessible learning experiences for those aspiring to become Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants.

In essence, my career is a testament to my unwavering passion for making a tangible difference in the lives of those seeking new beginnings in Canada. Through education, ethical practice, and a client-centered approach, I strive to guide individuals towards realizing their dreams of a prosperous life in Canada.

about_me_txt:
Manan Gupta, CEO of Skylake Immigration is a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant -IRB and member in good standing of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). He is licensed to practice as an Authorized Representative within the meaning of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (Canada) and the Citizenship Act (Canada) and the respective Government Regulations. He is a Commissioner of Oaths (Ontario) and also a registered member of the Canadian Association of Professional Immigration Consultants (CAPIC).

Skylake Immigration based in Brampton, Ontario provides exceptional service to its clients. It has a team of experienced and knowledgeable professionals who stay up-to-date with the latest developments in Canadian immigration law and policy and are committed to helping clients achieve their immigration goals.

Manan has over 25 years of experience of working in senior positions in media, supply chain and manufacturing sector. A passionate road safety advocate, Manan appears regularly on multicultural and mainstream media platforms like CBC News/Radio, Global News, Prime Asia, OMNI TV, 101.3FM, 1350 AM, and many more covering matters of immigration, public interest, transportation and community safety. He currently sits on the board of Ontario Safety League, Canadian Association of Road Safety Professionals, and the Automotive Transportation Service Superintendents’ Association, amongst others.

His volunteering efforts and contribution towards safer communities have been recognized through prestigious industry and government awards including the Ontario Ministry of Transportation Road Safety Media Excellence Award, Ontario Volunteer Service Award, arrive alive Drive Sober Media Tribute Award, Peel Police Media Excellence, CN Rail Safety Award, Queen’s Platinum Jubilee Award, City of Brampton Citizen’s Award, and more.

about_me_txt:
About me
Born and raised in Punjab, India, my journey to Canada six years ago sparked a profound interest in Canadian immigration and ignited a passion to pursue a career in this field. Prior to my arrival in Canada, I completed my Bachelor's in Computer Science and Engineering at Jalandhar, India. It was during this time that I developed a fascination with global cultures and a strong desire to assist individuals in navigating the complexities of immigration.
After settling in Canada, I eagerly sought opportunities to gain practical experience in immigration law. Drawing upon my educational background and my newfound passion, I dedicated myself to understanding the intricacies of Canadian immigration policies and procedures. This led me to open my own firm Cubical Immigration service Inc. where being a Regulated Canadian immigration consultant, I had the chance to apply my knowledge and skills to assist clients in achieving their immigration goals.

Beginning my journey into Immigration Law:
Driven by a deep-seated desire to positively influence the lives of individuals, I embarked on a path towards a career in immigration law. This aspiration culminated in my enrollment in the Graduate Diploma program in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen's University, Kingston to be a certified immigration consultant. Adhering to ethical practices and dedication to my client success, I earned my license as an RCIC-IRB under (CICC) College of Immigration and Citizenship consultants.

Founder and CEO at Cubical Immigration Services Inc.
Equipped with my RCIC-IRB license and driven by a vision of establishing a client-centered consultancy, I founded Cubical Immigration Services Inc. At Cubical Immigration Services Inc., we pledge a personalized approach and unwavering dedication to navigating clients through the complexities of the immigration process. My specialization encompasses a wide range of immigration streams, including Express Entry, family reunification through family/spousal sponsorship, Study Permit, Work Permit, OINP, Visitor Visa, Super Visa, citizenship and provincial nominee programs. With a focus on providing tailored solutions and exceptional service, Cubical Immigration Services Inc. is committed to guiding individuals towards their immigration goals with integrity and professionalism.

I am an educational consultant with the University of Regina, University of New Brunswick, Lethbridge University, Saskatchewan Polytechnic, and Luther College High School.

Having had a Master in Business Administration from the Delta State University, I later studied for four years bachelor’s degree at the prestigious University of Regina, where I graduated with an Academic Silver Prize Award. I later embarked on further studies at Queens University, Ontario, for a program in Immigration and Citizenship Law. I was Graded A in Refugees Protection, Economic Immigration, Temporary Entry, Enforcement, Foundational Knowledge, Family Class, Practice Management and Ethics, and professional responsibility.

For the partial fulfillment of the award in Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) degree, I committed an unpaid 270 hours with the Canadian Mental Health Association (CMHA), where she wrote a paper titled “Tracing the Issues Affecting Mental Health of Canada’s Newcomers.” I later proceeded to the University of Regina International Services for her primary practicum and committed 450 unpaid hours. During her significant field practice, she assisted in creating and presenting various Mental Health Awareness and Sharing Circles series. I connected with international students and supported them with various programs and support that matched their Individual Unique needs using competency models and theories.
Having worked with the international students’ services and written a paper on issues affecting newcomers, I formulated and championed various events for newcomers after the lockdown.

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education:
Born and raised in Paramaribo, Suriname, I developed a fascination with global cultures and a passion for helping others. I pursued undergraduate studies in Hospitality and Tourism Management at the Suriname College of Hospitality and Tourism Management, Paramaribo, Suriname and graduate studies in Tourism
Management at the Beijing International Studies University, Chaoyang, China.

Entry into Immigration Law:
I came to Canada searching for a hospitality job without success, I had no choice to accept a job in the farm. I discovered that most people weren't aware about the rights as a employee and how to maintain their legal status in Canada. I, myself, have been a victim of abuse in the workplace. Through my own experience and research I had educated my co-workers how to maintain their status as well.
The experiences I and my co-workers had, led me to pursue a career in immigration law. I completed a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen's University, Kingston, obtaining a solid foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures.

Founding Snow Path Immigration Consultancy Inc:
Armed with my RCIC license and a vision for a client-centric consultancy, I founded Snow Path Immigration Consultancy Inc. I promise personalized approach and commitment to guiding clients through the intricate immigration process. I specialize in various immigration streams, including Express Entry, Citizenship, Work Permit, OINP, Visitor Visa, Super Visa, and provincial nominee programs.

Professional Development and Continuous Learning:
Understanding the dynamic nature of immigration policies, I prioritize ongoing professional development. I attend conferences, workshops, and training sessions to stay informed of regulatory changes and emerging trends so that I can offer clients the most up-to-date and accurate advice.

about_me_txt:
From Chennai to Canada:
Embarking on a journey from Chennai, South India, to Canada marked the beginning of my mission to assist individuals with their immigration endeavors. With a background in business and corporate secretaryship, complemented by my extensive knowledge of immigration law as validated by my RCIC (Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant) license, I am equipped to guide others through the complex process of relocating to Canada.
My own migration to Canada was not without its challenges. Initially navigating with limited assistance, I encountered numerous obstacles. However, these experiences ignited within me a fervent dedication to help others facing similar difficulties.
Despite the absence of familial support in Canada, I persevered, relying on my resilience and the support of newfound friends who became my extended family.
Embarking on the Path of Immigration Advocacy:
Under the mentorship of a seasoned immigration consultant Ong boasting three decades of expertise, I gained invaluable insights. Additionally, I had the privilege of learning from the late Mr. Cecil L. Rotenberg. Their guidance, combined with personal experiences, propelled me towards a career in immigration law. My transition included contributions to Niren and Associates Immigration Law firm, where I managed immigration-related tasks, exclusively handled Permanent Residence Profiles, and undertook back-end accounting responsibilities and team leader assignments in PCLaw Entry into Immigration Laws.
Attaining Accreditation as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant:
Motivated by a desire to effectuate meaningful change in individuals' lives, I embarked on a journey in immigration law. This trajectory led me to attain a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Herzings College, Toronto, Canada, furnishing me with a robust understanding of Canadian immigration laws and procedures. Recognising the paramount importance of professional accreditation, I pursued becoming an RCIC under the aegis of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), obtaining my license through unwavering adherence to ethical standards and a steadfast commitment to client success.
Founding Taz Immigration Inc & ISAI.CA : New Chapter
Empowered by my RCIC license and driven by a vision of providing personalised, client-centric immigration consultancy, I established Taz Immigration Inc. My firm pledges a bespoke approach and unwavering support to navigate the intricate immigration process. Specialising in various immigration streams including Express Entry, Permanent Resident Applications, Family reunification, Study and Work permits, AAIP, Visitor Visas, Super visas, and Provincial nominee programs, we endeavour to cater to the diverse needs of our clientele. ISAI, the International Student Aim Inc, serves as a trailblazing multinational student service committed to advocating for the educational needs of students, including those from Latin America, India, Asia, and the Middle East. Our mission is to facilitate academic opportunities and provide related services both in Canada and globally.
Commitment to Lifelong Growth and Skill Development:
I prioritize continual professional development to stay abreast of regulatory shifts and emerging trends in immigration policies. This commitment guarantees that I provide my clients with the most accurate and current guidance available, ensuring their successful immigration journey to Canada.

about_me_txt:
My name is Maninder Kaur, RCIC-IRB, and my base of operations is in Welland, Ontario, which is close to the renowned Niagara Falls. I am a member of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).

I have a background in teaching and counselling students since 2006.Before immigrating to Canada, I use to explore different courses and career pathways for the students. During the course of time, I became more interested to explore different immigration pathways to Canada. To facilitate my journey towards Immigration, I have successfully acquired post graduate diploma in Immigration and Citizenship law from Queens University, Kingston. In addition to Gdip.ICL, I also hold Master's degree in Education from Punjab University and served as a lecturer for fifteen years. Before migrating to Canada, I counselled students to study abroad. I am also conferred MGPP award in year 2016 for being a best teacher and counsellor by the Ex President of India.

If you are an individual seeking for a tailored advice towards your Immigration journey to Canada, feel free to reach out to me.

about_me_txt:
I am a dedicated immigration professional with a diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, Kingston, Ontario. My passion lies in assisting individuals and families in navigating the complexities of immigration processes, helping them achieve their dreams of relocating to and establishing a new life in Canada.
As an immigrant myself, I have firsthand experience with the challenges, uncertainties, and aspirations that come with moving to a new country. This personal journey has given me a deep understanding of my clients' needs, allowing me to offer not only legal expertise but also empathy and guidance throughout their transition. I am committed to providing clear, reliable, and personalized support to make the immigration process as smooth and stress-free as possible.
Whether you are seeking to study, work, reunite with loved ones, or build a new future in Canada, I am here to help you navigate every step with confidence and clarity.

about_me_txt:
Hello there! and Bonjour! I couldn’t be more excited to introduce myself as a licensed Canadian immigration consultant who is passionate about making a positive impact in people’s lives. With 20 amazing years of experience as an IT consultant, I’ve found my calling in the world of immigration. My heart’s desire to make a difference led me to further education in Canadian Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen’s University in Kingston, Ontario. My motivation to help others achieve their aspirations has been the driving force behind my career.

As an immigration consultant, I get to make a difference every day. I understand that the process of immigrating to Canada can be complex and overwhelming, but I’m here to make it less daunting for you. With my expertise and empathetic approach, I’ll be there for you every step of the way, providing you with the guidance and support you need to succeed. I am genuinely passionate about my work. Whether you have questions about immigrating to Canada or you need help navigating the complex immigration process, I’m here for you.

I'm proud to be a licensed member of CICC and a registered member of CAPIC. I can practice before all IRCC divisions (ID, IAD, IRB, and RAD).

Please don't hesitate to reach out to me. I look forward to embarking on this journey with you! and let's work together to make your dream of immigrating to Canada a reality!

📩 kthibbles@kevinthibbles.com

📞 1-647-907-6890 | 🌐 www.kevinthibbles.com

advisor_data.bio:
I am Arshdeep Kaur based in Windsor, ON. I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant and run my immigration consulting firm, Breakway Immigration and Citizenship Services Inc.


I came to Canada as an international student and worked my way through what I am today. Before getting my RCIC license, I worked in IT Recruitment hiring skilled workers for the provincial governments and multinational IT companies. Having gone through the immigration process myself, I understand the struggles and challenges faced by individuals and families trying to make Canada their home.


This is why, at Breakway Immigration, I work as your partner and strategic advisor to help you navigate the complexities of immigration procedures. I take pride in offering transparent advice, tailored consultation and thorough application preparation.

advisor_data.bio:
Taibat is a member of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). She graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Chemistry from the University of Lagos and holds a bachelor’s degree in Social Work from York University. She is a Registered Social Worker with a growing interest in immigration and settlement matters. To further her expertise in this field, Taibat earned a Post-Graduate Diploma from Queen’s University and is now a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant. During her leisure time, she cherishes moments with her family and explores the outdoors.

As a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant, Taibat is dedicated to assisting clients in various immigration aspects, including:

• Moving to Canada,

• Sponsoring family members,

• Obtaining study permits, and

• Securing temporary work permits.

about_me_txt:
My name is Dunmoye Lawal. I am a Registered Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and a member in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants. After obtaining a bachelor’s degree in psychology and Addiction Counseling, I completed my post-graduation degree in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queens University.

Our company, Damjoy Immigration Consulting Inc., specializes in advising and representing clients about Canadian immigration applications. We guide individuals and families through the intricacies of Canadian immigration. Our mission is to turn your Canadian dreams into a reality, offering a comprehensive range of immigration services tailored to your unique needs such as securing temporary work permits (LMIA), study permits, visitors’ records, post-graduation work permits, and Canadian citizenship.

We believe in a client-centered approach, where your aspirations become our mission. We take the time to understand your goals, address your concerns, and craft customized solutions that align with your unique circumstances.

I possesses a Bachelor’s degree in engineering, and Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University.

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education
My parents immigrated to Canada in the 90s after the civil war in Somalia. After high school, I attended the University of Ottawa where I obtained a degree in Public Administration. I worked at Passport Canada and IRCC in the ROCO department handling intake applications for Refugee sponsorship for group five, community sponsors, and SAHs. After my experience at IRCC I felt inspired to pursue further education in Immigration related field.

Entry into Immigration Law
I developed a desire to pursue immigration Law Studies at Queen University. I felt drawn to the field because it offered the opportunity to be self-employed and provide valuable service to immigrants. I completed my Diploma in Immigration & Citizenship Law at Queen University and received my License to practice in July 2023.

Amal Mahamud Immigration Consultancy (AM-IC)
Soon after receiving my LOA, I embarked on a journey to complete PME and various CPD professional development seminars/workshops to stay in tune with the fast past and ever-changing regulatory changes to ensure I am always providing the best service. My goal is to provide exceptional service in areas such as Express Entry, Visitor Visa, Study Permit, Work Permit, Spousal Applications; Super Visa, and Provincial Nominee Programs H&C and Private Group five sponsorships.

about_me_txt:
Life and Education before becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant:
My journey before becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) was characterized by a rich tapestry of cultural experiences and educational pursuits. Born in Asia and raised in Europe, my formative years were marked by a multicultural upbringing that instilled in me a deep appreciation for global diversity. Growing up amidst diverse cultural interactions, I developed fluency in navigating multicultural environments from a young age. My family's diverse origins further enriched my understanding of global dynamics, as we collectively embraced Canada as our home over the past three decades.

After completing high school in Toronto, Ontario, I pursued a Master's degree in Fine Arts at the University of West Florida. Subsequently, I embarked on a professional journey that led me to a rewarding position with Apple in Austin, Texas. Throughout my tenure there, I had the privilege of interacting with a myriad of individuals from various backgrounds, enhancing my ability to connect with people from all walks of life. These experiences imbued me with the confidence, empathy, and effective communication skills essential for engaging with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds across the globe.

The Journey into Immigration Law:
The pandemic prompted a period of introspection for many of us, leading me to reassess my long-term aspirations. During the months of global pause, I contemplated where I envisioned myself in the decades to come. It became evident that my passion for assisting others aligned seamlessly with a career in immigration law, offering me the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a global scale.

The path to becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) was undoubtedly challenging, marked by numerous trials and valuable lessons that evolved into essential skills. This recognition, coupled with obtaining the RCIC license, fills me with optimism for the future. As I reflect on the privilege of aiding and guiding new immigrants to Canada, I am reminded of my own journey upon arriving in this country. The opportunity to support others as they embark on a similar path is a profound blessing—a chance to extend the same kindness that was once bestowed upon me. Paying forward these acts of goodwill is truly a privilege I eagerly anticipate.

Inception of Monolith Immigration Services:
Even before obtaining my license, I envisioned the establishment of Monolith Immigration Consulting Canada. The choice of 'Monolith' as our company name reflects our unwavering dedication to offering steadfast support and guidance to individuals navigating the intricate path of immigration. It symbolizes resilience, stability, and enduring strength in the face of adversity. Recognizing the myriad challenges associated with relocating to a new country, I aim to assure each client that regardless of external changes, Monolith Immigration Consulting Canada's commitment remains steadfast. Our array of services encompasses Study Permit (Post-Secondary, Post Graduate Work Permit, Super Visa), Visitor Record, Express Entry Program, Canadian Experience Class, Parents and Grandparents Program, Visitor Visa, Family and Spousal Sponsorship, and Restoration of Status, among others.

about_me_txt:
As a Licensed Immigration Consultant (RCIC) regulated by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC) , I specialize in guiding clients through Canada’s complex immigration pathways, with expertise in:
Student Visas : Strategic study permit applications, refusal reversals, and post-graduation pathway planning. Express Entry : Comprehensive CRS score optimization, Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) linkages, and application management. Visitor Visas : Tailored applications for tourism, family visits, and super visa approvals. Business Immigration : Start-up visas, entrepreneur programs, and LMIA-backed work permits.
Beyond individual cases, I am deeply engaged in public policy analysis , advocating for equitable and efficient immigration systems. My work includes collaborating with stakeholders to address gaps in policy implementation and mentoring aspiring immigration professionals to uphold the highest ethical standards in the field.
With a passion for empowering clients to achieve their Canadian dreams and a commitment to shaping forward-thinking immigration frameworks, I bridge the gap between policy and practice—one successful application at a time.
Let’s navigate your journey together.

about_me_txt:
With a background in Immigration and Relocation, Recruitment, and Event Management, I know first-hand the challenges of getting people from A to B. It takes candour, attention to detail and consistent open communication.

To me, immigration allows for new opportunities and new perspectives. Immigration allows people to start a new chapter in their life, reunite with family, build a diverse workforce, take on new business ventures and facilitate the transfer knowledge that builds Canada's economy and communities. It's exciting, and I'm excited to be a part of it.

Passion for and devotion to my work comes from helping employers and employees create an immigration strategy that is both time and cost-effective for everyone involved. I help achieve the results you need by managing the details professionally and precisely.

I became a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) in 2015, but I previously worked for companies within their Human Resource and Recruitment departments, navigating the complex and ever-changing Canadian Immigration System.

I hold a Certificate in Immigration: Laws, Policies and Procedures from the University of British Columbia, a Human Resources Management Certificate from the British Columbia Institute of Technology, and a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Communication from Simon Fraser University.

about_me_txt:
Vineet Bhatia, the driving force behind VisAvi Immigration, is an Ex-Immigration Officer with a wealth of experience in immigration processing, assessment, and team management. With a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law (GDipICL) from the prestigious Queen’s University, Canada, Vineet brings both academic expertise and practical knowledge to the table.

Vineet's journey in the field of immigration began as a Visa Officer at the Australian High Commission in New Delhi, India, where he honed his skills in assessing and deciding visa applications according to the Australian legislative framework. Over the years, Vineet has held various pivotal roles in various diplomatic missions, including as a Non-Immigrant Officer at the High Commission of Canada (New Delhi, India) and as a Visa Processing Associate at the American Embassy (New Delhi, India).

His commitment to excellence and dedication to client satisfaction led him to obtain licensure as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) - IRB, ensuring that clients receive the highest quality of service and ethical guidance. He is also a member of the Canadian Association of Professional Immigration Consultants (CAPIC).

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education:
Born and raised in Kitchener, Ontario, I have always had an interest in history, geography, politics, and other cultures & languages. I was an underachiever as a teenager but then finally finding my place I went back to school later in life, at 24. I graduated from Wilfrid Laurier University in Waterloo with a Bachelor of Arts, Honours Global Studies. My studies mostly focused on war & conflict, political science, the Middle East, Islam, and Arabic.

Entry into Immigration Law:
I completed my Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen's University, Kingston, obtaining a solid foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures in January 2023.

I received my license in late November 2023 and then immediately began working for Shree Hari Ltd. who have recently set up a branch in Kitchener, Ontario. Our home office is based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India and the company overall employs around 150 people with 6 other branches. We focus largely on Indian based immigration applications and have a breadth of case types knowledge and experience. Here at the Canada branch though we are a small group and tight knit.


Future in Immigration Law:
I hope in the future I will again return to school to become a full-fledged lawyer and continue my progress in the career of immigration law.

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education:
Born and raised in Punjab, India, I completed my bachelor’s degree at Thapar University in Patiala. My journey led me to Vancouver, where I became a Permanent Resident. The intricacies of the express entry process piqued my interest in immigration, prompting me to pursue further education in this field. I graduated from Queen's University in Kingston with a degree in Citizenship and Immigration Law, which provided me with a strong foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures.
Becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant:
Driven by the importance of professional accreditation, I aimed to become a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) through the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). My commitment to ethical practices and dedication to client success enabled me to obtain my RCIC license.
Founding Respir:
Upon recognizing a significant need for authorized immigration representatives in my home state of Punjab, I established Respir to address the shortage and combat the issue of ghost consultants and illegal practices. With offices in Bathinda and the neighboring city of Giddarbaha, I offer a personalized approach and dedicated support to clients navigating the complex immigration process. My expertise spans various immigration streams, including Express Entry, family reunification (family/spousal sponsorship), Study Permits, Work Permits, AAIP, Visitor Visas, Super Visas, and provincial nominee programs.
Professional Development and Continuous Learning:
Acknowledging the ever-evolving nature of immigration policies, I prioritize ongoing professional development. By attending conferences, workshops, and training sessions, I stay updated on regulatory changes and emerging trends to provide clients with the most accurate and current advice.

To stay informed about the latest immigration news and updates, I continuously educate myself on evolving regulations. My aim is to empower my clients with the knowledge they need to navigate their immigration journey confidently, making their transition smoother and more successful.

about_me_txt:
I'm Abdullah Al Mashud, an esteemed Canadian Regulated Immigration Consultant dedicated to facilitating seamless immigration experiences for individuals and families striving towards their Canadian aspirations. Having embarked on my immigration journey to Canada in 2017 as an international student, I intimately understand the challenges and triumphs that accompany the pursuit of a new life in this vibrant nation.

With a distinguished Canadian Master's degree and a prestigious diploma in Immigration Consultancy, I possess the expertise to navigate the complexities of Canadian immigration law with finesse and precision. Moreover, my extensive firsthand experience in navigating immigration systems across the US, Middle East, Europe, and Latin America equips me with a global perspective that enriches my ability to serve clients from diverse backgrounds.

I am passionate about assisting the South Asian population, particularly the Bangli-speaking, and their diaspora in the Gulf countries, Latin America, and beyond in realizing their Canadian dreams. With specializations in visit visas, super visas, study permits, post-graduate study permits, work permits, family immigration, provincial nomination, entrepreneurship, investment visas, refugee claims, and citizenship, I offer comprehensive solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Whether you're aspiring to reunite with loved ones, pursue educational endeavours, explore entrepreneurial opportunities, or seek refuge and citizenship in Canada, I am here to provide unwavering support and guidance throughout your immigration journey.

Let's collaborate to turn your Canadian dreams into reality, one step at a time.

Manjura Rehman is the Founder and CEO of ACT-NOW IMMIGRATION SERVICES INC. , and a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC), licensed by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC) and authorized by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) to represent clients in all immigration matters.
The College regulates and oversees the practice of Canadian immigration and citizenship consultants to ensure they meet rigorous professional standards. Under Canadian law, it is a serious offence to offer immigration advice or representation for a fee without being licensed by the College. Clients can trust that Manjura’s services are fully compliant, lawful, and grounded in integrity.
As a licensed member of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, Manjura is committed to upholding the highest standards of professional conduct and ethical practice.
Manjura holds a Master’s degree and brings a strong academic and professional background to the field of immigration consultancy. Her practice is dedicated to assisting clients with a comprehensive range of immigration services, with particular expertise in Express Entry , Family Sponsorships , Start-Up Visas , and Business Immigration programs.She provides services in various other immigration programs. To know her expertise you can also browse the services section of https://actnowimmigrationservices.com

She is deeply committed to providing professional, transparent, and client-centered services. Every case is handled with meticulous attention to detail, honesty, and a personalized approach designed to maximize the chances of a successful outcome.
Whether you are looking to build a future in Canada through skilled immigration pathways, reunite with family members, or establish a business presence in Canada, Manjura is here to guide you through every step of the immigration process with clarity, efficiency, and professionalism.
She looks forward to assisting you in achieving your Canadian immigration goals.

about_me_txt:
My journey as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant is motivated by my own experience as an immigrant. I am Kashmala Chaudhry an immigrant from Pakistan.
While I was exploring different immigration options to come to Canada and was trying to gather correct information amid the influx of information, I remember how emotionally and logistically draining that time was. about_me_txt:
About Me
My name is Olawumi Fayemi, and I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). I hold a bachelor’s degree in business administration and a Graduate Diploma in Immigration Law and Citizenship from Queen's University, Kingston, where I gained a solid foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures.
As an immigrant myself, I understand the complexities of the immigration process and how challenging it can be to settle in a new country, especially with constantly changing laws and policies. That’s why I founded Mignect Immigration Services Canada, with the goal of providing professional, client-centred services and prioritizing clients' best interests.
Becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant
With a commitment to ethical practices and client success, I pursued professional accreditation and became an RCIC under the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).
Mignect Immigration Services
With my RCIC license, I established Mignect Immigration Services to offer personalized guidance through the complex immigration process. I specialize in a range of immigration pathways, including Express Entry, family reunification (spousal/family sponsorship), Study Permits, Work Permits, AAIP, Visitor Visas, Super Visas, and Provincial Nominee Programs.
Professional Development and Continuous Learning
To keep up with ever-evolving immigration policies, I prioritize ongoing professional development by attending conferences, workshops, and training sessions. This ensures I provide clients with the most accurate and up-to-date advice.

I specialize in assisting global clients secure Canadian visitor visas for business activities and for tourism including:
• Federal Government engagements
• Church conventions for pastors
• Annual corporate events
• Intra-company trainings
• Company events
• Conferences
• Weddings
• Tourism
My articles are drawn from real-world experiences, handling numerous visa applications in a fast-paced corporate environment. Each insight and tip shared here comes from actual cases, challenges overcome, and solutions that work. To date, I have a 99% visa approval rate, which I am grateful for and aim to maintain.
Stay updated with practical immigration tips by following my weekly articles.

advisor_data.bio:
As a licensed immigration consultant, I’ve dedicated my career to guiding individuals and families through the Canadian immigration system with clarity, compassion, and strategy. My approach is rooted in truly understanding each client’s unique background and goals, and tailoring solutions that are both realistic and forward-thinking. Whether someone is facing a complex situation or just starting their journey, I aim to make the process more approachable and informed.

With a background that blends legal knowledge, real-world case experience, and a strong grasp of evolving immigration policies, I work to build solid applications that tell a clear and compelling story. I’m also committed to continuous learning and innovation—adapting tools and technology to improve efficiency, accuracy, and client experience. For me, this work is not just about paperwork; it’s about helping people find stability, opportunity, and a sense of belonging in Canada.

about_me_txt:
Sanjeev Verma is an experienced Canadian Immigration Professional with a proven track record of high performance and achievement. He currently serves as a leader at AVANDRA IMMIGRATION SERVICES, where he leverages his extensive expertise in the field of immigration.

Throughout his over 32 years career within IRCC and CBSA, Sanjeev has demonstrated strong leadership skills and a progressive approach to his work. His ability to adapt to changing circumstances and navigate complex immigration processes has made him a valuable asset in his field. He has served as a Canadian Diplomat in Hong Kong, USA, China, India and Thailand.

Sanjeev's professional profile highlights his commitment to excellence and his dedication to helping clients navigate the intricacies of Canadian immigration. His expertise likely covers various aspects of the immigration process, including visa applications, permanent residency, and citizenship procedures. Sanjeev has extensive experience in administering and managing Port of Entry operations, Inland operations, Enforcement (detention & removals) and overseas operations within the context of immigration and border management.

With his comprehensive understanding of Canadian immigration laws and policies, Sanjeev is well-equipped to provide guidance and support to individuals and families seeking to immigrate to Canada. His role at AVANDRA IMMIGRATION SERVICES allows him to utilize his skills and knowledge to assist clients in achieving their immigration goals.

about_me_txt:
Hi! I’m Mansi , the founder of D2V Immigration , a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and Commissioner of Oaths in Ontario. With a background in Immigration Law from Queen’s University, I bring a unique combination of legal expertise and practical insight to help individuals and families navigate their immigration journeys to Canada.

Having immigrated to Canada myself in 2017, I understand firsthand the challenges and aspirations of starting a new life in a foreign country. This personal experience drives my commitment to making the immigration process smoother and less overwhelming for my clients.

At D2V Immigration, I provide a wide range of services, from visa applications to permanent residency pathways, tailored to your unique needs. Whether you’re a student beginning an exciting chapter, a family hoping to make Canada your home, or a professional exploring new opportunities, I’m here to guide you every step of the way.

For me, being an RCIC is more than just a profession—it’s a passion. I believe in building strong, trusting relationships with my clients and empowering them to achieve their dreams.

Your dreams matter to me as much as they matter to you. Together, we’ll turn your aspirations into reality and make your Canadian journey a seamless and rewarding experience.

Let’s make your Canadian journey a seamless and successful experience!

about_me_txt:
Background
Born and raised in Nassau, Bahamas, I immigrated to Canada in 2005 to pursue my bachelor's degree in business administration. My personal experience with the Canadian immigration process, from student to worker to permanent resident and finally citizen, has given me special insight into the challenges my clients face throughout their own immigration journeys and informs my approach to every interaction with them.
I leverage my unique background and knowledge gained through my work as a Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB) and Payroll Compliance Professional (PCP), combined with my Graduate Diploma in Immigration & Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, to help others navigate the complexities of the Canadian immigration system and achieve their immigration goals. The intersection of these distinctive skill sets has allowed me to provide a truly client-centred experience while gaining hands-on experience in various Canadian immigration programs.
Harbour Cave Immigration Consulting Inc.
Upon fulfilling the stringent licensing requirements set out by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), I earned my RCIC-IRB license in 2024 and started Harbour Cave Immigration Consulting.
At Harbour Cave Immigration, we are dedicated to providing personalised expert immigration consulting services grounded in integrity, unwavering optimism and deep knowledge - fueled by a commitment to lifelong learning. Our mission is to empower clients by offering clear, reliable guidance through every step of their immigration journey, always with empathy and a positive outlook, ensuring that their dreams of a new life are met with hope and confidence.
I believe everyone deserves a chance to build the future of their dreams – Harbour Cave is here to help.

about_me_txt:
I am a dedicated professional with 15 years of experience in the engineering field and a newfound passion for immigration consulting. My journey into the immigration profession was deeply inspired by my own experience navigating the immigration system as an engineer. This firsthand exposure gave me a profound understanding of the complexities, challenges, and emotions involved in building a new life in a different country.
Throughout my engineering career, I honed key skills such as analytical thinking, problem-solving, and meticulous attention to detail—qualities that naturally complement my work in immigration consulting. I approach each client’s case with the same diligence and precision that I applied to large-scale engineering projects, ensuring tailored, effective solutions for every unique situation.
My personal immigration journey taught me the importance of empathy, resilience, and thorough planning. I am committed to using these insights to guide others through the immigration process, whether they are skilled professionals, families, or individuals seeking new opportunities abroad.
My mission is to make the immigration process smoother and more approachable for my clients. I believe in empowering people with clear information, actionable steps, and unwavering support to help them achieve their goals.
If you’re looking for someone who not only understands the technical aspects of immigration but also truly relates to the emotional and practical challenges it entails, I’d be honored to assist you on your journey.

about_me_txt:
I am Kelechi Daniel, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB), R1034411 ( verify status ) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (the body which regulates the profession of Immigration Consultants in Canada) and the CEO of LaFav Travels Immigration Services Inc.

I have lived, visited, worked in Nigeria, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Ghana, France and still counting. Travel is a hobby and Immigration my number one (1) passion.

I am deeply involved in immigration matters from different perspectives, including immigration policies and social adaptation of immigrants. I hold a diploma in Immigration & Citizenship Law and two Masters degrees in Engineering and Management supporting a stronger immigration practice puting my clients at the core of my firm's operations, serving them to the best of my ability.

At the core of my practice lies values: Confidentiality, Competence and Credibilty. I am a strong supporter of transparency, accuracy, and professional ethics. Respect for clients, Inclusion, diversity, equity and accessibility inform my style of work. I provide services in English and support my non-English speaking clients by providing guidance on how to find certified interpreters. Great customer services to my clients is my number one objective.

I offer a wide variety of immigration services, including temporary entry visas (visit, work and study permits), permanent residence, citizenship, as well as other immigration services such as PR Card renewals etc.

I am happy to assist you in your immigration journey!

about_me_txt:
Early Life and Education
Born and raised in Pakistan, I have always been passionate about helping individuals navigate the complexities of immigration—a journey I deeply understand as an immigrant myself. I earned my Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Banking and Finance, equipping me with strong analytical and problem-solving skills essential for guiding clients through immigration pathways.

Journey into Immigration Consulting
My firsthand experience with the immigration process fueled my desire to support others in achieving their Canadian dreams. To build expertise, I completed the Immigration Case Manager Course at Herzing College, Toronto, in 2022, followed by the Immigration Assistant Program at the Academy of Learning, Mississauga, in 2024. In the same year, I successfully obtained my Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, Kingston, gaining a solid foundation in Canadian immigration laws and procedures.

Becoming a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC)
With a deep commitment to ethical, transparent, and client-focused immigration services, I pursued professional accreditation and earned my license as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) under the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).

Professional Knowledge
I have developed a strong understanding of various Canadian immigration programs, including:

•	Express Entry
•	Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs)
•	Study Permits
•	Work Permits
•	Family and Spousal Sponsorship
•	Visitor Visas & Super Visas

Commitment to Excellence
Understanding the ever-evolving nature of immigration policies, I prioritize continuous professional development. I regularly attend industry conferences, training programs, and legal workshops to stay updated on regulatory changes and best practices. My goal is to provide clients with accurate, up-to-date, and strategic immigration solutions tailored to their unique needs.

about_me_txt:
My name is Isha Dade, and I’m a Canadian-born Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and the proud face behind Future Advice Immigration Solutions Inc. As someone who has always believed in fairness, opportunity, and community, I have committed my career to helping others find their path to a better future in Canada.
As a Canadian by birth, I’ve grown up witnessing the strength, diversity, and stories of immigrants around me. I understand how overwhelming and intimidating the immigration process can feel—because I’ve helped family, friends, and now countless clients navigate it firsthand. My approach is rooted in empathy, honesty, and personalized care. I listen. I explain. And I walk alongside my clients from start to finish.
I hold an Honours Bachelor of Applied Science in Justice Studies from the University of Guelph-Humber, where I focused on legal systems, human rights, and administrative law. This was followed by a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, one of Canada’s most respected institutions. My academic background provides me with the legal depth and policy knowledge needed to handle even the most complex immigration matters.
I’ve worked in multiple law firms and in Human Resources, where I developed hands-on expertise in documentation, casework, and client relations. These roles taught me how to manage sensitive cases with professionalism and compassion—and how to deliver results without cutting corners.
Today, as a fully licensed RCIC-IRB, I specialize in a wide range of immigration services, including Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), Work and Study Permits, Labour Market Impact Assessments (LMIAs), Spousal and Family Sponsorships, Humanitarian and Compassionate (H&C) Applications, Restoration of Status and Extension Applications, Refugee Claims and IRB Representation, Canadian Citizenship Applications, and Procedural Fairness and Inadmissibility Responses.
Every application is handled with a thorough, strategic, and ethical approach. I never rush a case or take a one-size-fits-all path. Each file represents a real person with hopes, challenges, and a future worth investing in—and I treat it with the respect it deserves.
Clients consistently tell me that they appreciate my calm communication style, transparency, and ability to break down complex information. I am fluent in English, Hindi, and Punjabi, which allows me to connect authentically with many of my clients in their first language. My goal is always to make the process feel less stressful, more understandable, and most of all—possible.
Though based in Brampton, Ontario, I serve clients all across Canada and internationally through virtual consultations. Whether you're inside Canada or overseas, I offer flexible appointment options and accessible support tailored to your schedule and needs.
Let’s turn your Canadian immigration goals into reality—together. Book a consultation today and take the first step toward a future built on trust, knowledge, and professional guidance.
You can reach me at isha.immigrationservices@gmail.com

As the founder and lead consultant at TMS Immigration LTD ., I take pride in guiding individuals through their Canadian immigration journey. My RCIC certification (# R1034258 ) reflects my commitment to maintaining the highest standards of immigration consulting practice.
My path to immigration consulting started by my education at Queen's University, where I completed the Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law. Having established my practice in Prince George, I bring a unique northern perspective to immigration services, understanding both the challenges and opportunities that Canada's northern regions present to newcomers.
What sets my approach apart is my dedication to continuous growth and adaptability in this ever-evolving field. I believe that successful immigration consulting requires not just expertise in current regulations, but also a forward-thinking mindset that anticipates changes in immigration policies and procedures. At TMS Immigration LTD., this philosophy translates into personalized solutions that align with each client's unique circumstances and goals.

I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) and a member in good standing of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC) with college ID R731607. I have completed the Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from the Queen's University, Kingston, which has solidified my knowledge and practicum in immigration laws and policies.

Originally from India, I moved permanently to Canada in 2015 with my family. I have completed my Masters in Technology (M.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering from the Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar. This accreditation helps me navigate the complexities of the (mostly) online-based world of the Canadian immigration system. Since becoming licensed, I have started my immigration firm named OptiWays Immigration Inc.

I regularly attend webinars, conferences and professional development seminars, to keep myself up-to-date with the ever evolving immigration policies and procedures and help my clients in the best way.

I specialize in various streams like Express Entry, Parent Grandparent Program, Family Sponsorship, Open Work Permit, Citizenship, Study Permit, AAIP, Visitor/Super Visa.

Being an immigrant myself, I am aware of the challenges and hurdles experienced by newcomers to Canada. I entered this industry as I have the zest to help people overcome those challenges and make their journey smooth. Whether you are applying from your home country or are already here, I can help in every leg of your immigration journey to a better future.

about_me_txt:
I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) based in Ontario, authorized by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC) to provide professional immigration services. With extensive knowledge of Canadian immigration laws, policies, and procedures, I assist individuals, families, and businesses in navigating the complexities of the immigration process.

My expertise covers various immigration programs, including permanent residence, temporary visas, work permits, study permits, family sponsorships, refugee claims, Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), and representation before the Immigration and Refugee Board (IRB). I am committed to offering ethical, transparent, and client-focused immigration solutions, ensuring a smooth and efficient journey for my clients.

Whether you are looking to immigrate to Canada, sponsor a loved one, or seek professional representation for immigration matters, I am here to provide trusted guidance and tailored support.

about_me_txt:
I am a licensed immigration consultant helping people realize their Canadian dream. Being an immigrant myself I understand the challenges faced by people who are concerned navigating the complex Canadian immigration landscape.

At Saranova Immigration Inc. , I serve as the founder, committed to helping individuals and families successfully navigate Canada’s complex immigration process. Backed by an RCIC-IRB License and a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, Canada, I bring knowledge and professionalism to the field. My approach focuses on carefully assessing each client’s background to determine the most suitable immigration pathway for their unique circumstances.

My background as a military veteran and an aerospace engineer keeps me motivated to handle complex cases and helps me stay abreast with fast changing Canadian immigration policies.

Beyond my professional responsibilities, I am a dedicated food security advocate in the GTA, volunteering to provide meals to seniors, individuals with disabilities, children, and students.

I am committed to supporting my clients at every step of their journey—because every immigration story is unique, and together, we can write your Canadian story!

My name is Paola Gongora, I was born in Bogota, Colombia, but immigrated to Canada over twenty years ago. I am fluent in Spanish and English which allows me to connect with the Spanish community. I hold a Bachelors degree in political science and a Bachelors degree in Law and society from the University of Calgary. I became a licensed RCIC in early 2024 and I am currently a Member at the Immigration Refugee Protection Division where I decide refugee claims.

Prior to this, I worked for over five years in social services where I provided case management, employment services, and program development. I hold significant experience working with individuals struggling with homelessness, mental health, and addiction. My passion for helping vulnerable populations allows me to develop strong rapports with clients and to advocate for their best interests.

I am currently on leave and therefore not accepting new clients, but I look forward to working with clients from various immigration backgrounds.

about_me_txt:
I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) committed to providing ethical, transparent, and strategic immigration guidance. With over 20 years of experience spanning academia and industry, I bring a unique blend of legal, business, and educational expertise to help individuals and families navigate their immigration journey to Canada.

Holding a Doctorate in Management, an MBA in Marketing, and dual degrees in Commerce and Law, I have developed a strong foundation in policy, regulations, and strategic decision-making. My journey has taken me from Ahmedabad University, where I taught for 14 years, to the University of Saskatchewan, and I have had the privilege of teaching at Cambridge University (UK), Keio University (Japan), and Olin College of Engineering (USA).

Beyond immigration consulting, I am passionate about mentoring students and professionals, helping them make informed career and settlement decisions. Recognizing the rise in immigration fraud, I am committed to ethical and client-centered services, ensuring individuals and families receive reliable and transparent guidance.

I believe in integrity, collaboration, and commitment—values that define my work as both an educator and an immigration consultant. Whether guiding a student toward their dream university or helping a skilled professional secure permanent residence, my goal is to empower lives through informed decision-making.

about_me_txt:
Luz Elena Garrido, R731350, is a highly-trained Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) with a robust background in business and marketing, spanning over 20 years in the private sector.
Originally from Chile, Luz Elena studied Business Administration at Arturo Prat University and after moving to Canada, she furthered her education with studies in Marketing and a Bachelor’s degree in Business and Liberal Studies from Simon Fraser University. Her academic journey culminated with a postgraduate degree in Immigration Law from Queen’s University.
Luz Elena meets all the stringent requirements set by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC) . She has completed the specialized program designed for RCICs, equipping her with the necessary knowledge, skills, and judgment to practice before the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB) . This board is Canada’s largest independent administrative tribunal, established by the Parliament of Canada to adjudicate on immigration and refugee matters. Through passing the specialization exam, Luz Elena obtained her RCIC-IRB licence (R731350) , affirming her capability to represent clients safely and ethically in the public interest.
As a member of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, Luz Elena adheres to the highest standards of professional conduct. The College regulates the practice of Canadian immigration and citizenship consultants, and it is a punishable offence for anyone to provide Canadian immigration advice for a fee without being licensed by the College.
Luz Elena is deeply passionate about helping individuals and families from both Spanish and English-speaking communities achieve their dreams of immigrating to Canada. Her personal experience as an immigrant provides her with a unique perspective and empathy, understanding the challenges and complexities of starting anew in a different country and culture. She believes in the opportunities and safety Canada offers to those seeking a better future for themselves and their loved ones.
Dedicated to providing ethical, professional, and compassionate assistance, Luz Elena brings a wealth of experience and a heartfelt commitment to her role. She is dedicated to guiding her clients through every step of the immigration process, ensuring they receive the best possible support and representation.

about_me_txt:
The Journey to Canada
In 2017, I moved to Canada as an international student, eager to further my education and build a new life in a country full of opportunities. I earned two master’s degrees in Engineering, with the most recent from the University of Guelph in 2019. My professional career flourished, leading me to become a Senior Engineer (P.Eng) at one of Canada’s largest engineering consulting firms. However, throughout my journey, I encountered numerous immigration challenges firsthand and saw many others struggle due to misinformation and unreliable resources.

The Realization and Commitment
As I navigated my own immigration process, I quickly realized that many people were being misled by unreliable sources and that even small mistakes could have life-changing consequences. To truly make a difference, I needed the right knowledge and credentials. This led me to pursue a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law at Queen's University in 2024 and become a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) with the highest level of licensing (Level 3) under the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).

The Birth of Lavender Immigration Services
With my expertise in both engineering and immigration, I established Lavender Immigration Services to provide ethical, personalized, and effective immigration solutions. My goal was to create a firm that prioritizes integrity, professionalism, and care, ensuring that clients receive personalized and tailored guidance that meets their immigration goals.

With over 32 years of experience in the Canadian immigration system, Peri has established herself as an exceptional immigration professional with comprehensive expertise and a proven track record of success.

Peri's career began at the Immigration and Refugee Board (IRB), Citizenship and Immigration Canada (CIC), and the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA), where she developed invaluable institutional knowledge from multiple perspectives. Her extensive work alongside reputable immigration lawyers has equipped her with practical expertise in various aspects of immigration law and procedures.

Throughout her distinguished career with IRCC, CBSA, and CIC, Peri has consistently demonstrated the highest levels of integrity and honesty. Her professional approach combines technical expertise with genuine compassion, recognizing the human elements in every immigration case. Peri's areas of specialization include refugee claim applications, family sponsorship applications, citizenship processes, permanent residency applications, work permit, study permit and visa applications, as well as humanitarian and compassionate applications.

As an educator, Peri brings immaculate attention to detail to her work, ensuring that every immigration file she prepares meets the highest standards of precision and thoroughness. Her background in teaching has cultivated exceptional organizational skills and a methodical approach, allowing her to navigate complex immigration requirements with meticulous care. This educational foundation is evident in how she diligently reviews documentation, anticipates potential challenges, and creates flawless submissions that stand up to rigorous scrutiny.

Peri's commitment to excellence and dedication to her clients has made her a trusted advisor for individuals navigating their immigration journey. Her unique combination of comprehensive knowledge, practical experience, and compassionate approach allows her to provide well-rounded guidance and support tailored to each client's specific needs.
