Her extensive work alongside reputable immigration lawyers has equipped her with practical expertise in various aspects of immigration law and procedures.

  

Throughout her distinguished career with IRCC, CBSA, and CIC, Peri has consistently demonstrated the highest levels of integrity and honesty. Her professional approach combines technical expertise with genuine compassion, recognizing the human elements in every immigration case. Peri's areas of specialization include refugee claim applications, family sponsorship applications, citizenship processes, permanent residency applications, work permit, study permit and visa applications, as well as humanitarian and compassionate applications.

  

As an educator, Peri brings immaculate attention to detail to her work, ensuring that every immigration file she prepares meets the highest standards of precision and thoroughness. Her background in teaching has cultivated exceptional organizational skills and a methodical approach, allowing her to navigate complex immigration requirements with meticulous care. This educational foundation is evident in how she diligently reviews documentation, anticipates potential challenges, and creates flawless submissions that stand up to rigorous scrutiny.

  

Peri's commitment to excellence and dedication to her clients has made her a trusted advisor for individuals navigating their immigration journey. Her unique combination of comprehensive knowledge, practical experience, and compassionate approach allows her to provide well\-rounded guidance and support tailored to each client's specific needs.

about_me_txt: As an immigrant from Pakistan, I personally experienced the emotional and logistical challenges of navigating Canada’s immigration system. That journey inspired me to help others facing similar uncertainty. Recognizing the growing need for trusted, licensed professionals in this space, I founded WQA Immigration Services to offer reliable, client-focused immigration guidance. We assist with a broad range of immigration pathways, including Express Entry, PNP, LMIA, Work Permits, Spousal and Visitor Visas, and Business Immigration. As a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and a graduate of Queen’s University’s Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law, I combine legal expertise with a solid foundation in research analysis to stay informed on evolving immigration policies. At WQA Immigration Services, I am committed to supporting individuals and families through every stage of their immigration journey because immigration isn’t just about moving countries, it’s about building a better future.

about_me_txt:
Sernur is passionate about helping people navigate the complexities of the immigration system. With a background as an international student advisor for leading educational institutions, she brings warmth, expertise, and a personal touch to every interaction. Her deep understanding of immigration pathways, especially for students and professionals, allows her to offer strategic, well-informed guidance tailored to each client’s unique circumstances.

Since moving to Canada in 2021 with her husband, daughter, and their beloved cat, Sernur has embraced her new home with enthusiasm and resilience. She understands firsthand the challenges and opportunities of building a new life in Canada, making her an empathetic advocate for those going through the immigration process.

She is committed to ensuring that every client receives thorough, accurate, and results-driven support, treating each case with the same dedication.

Beyond her professional role, Sernur enjoys staying informed about global migration trends and policy changes, continuously expanding her expertise to better serve her clients. When she’s not helping people achieve their Canadian dreams, you’ll find her watching inspiring movies based on true stories, exploring new cultures, or cherishing quality time with her family.

Hello, my name is Feng Zhang, and I’m a licensed immigration consultant dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex process of immigrating to Canada. With a strong background in settlement services and a deep understanding of immigration policies, I specialize in guiding clients through a variety of immigration pathways—including permanent residency, work and study permits, family sponsorships, and citizenship applications.

My approach is client-centered and detail-oriented. I take the time to understand each client’s unique situation and goals, and I work diligently to provide personalized advice and ensure all applications are accurate, complete, and timely. Whether you’re planning to come to Canada for work, study, or to reunite with loved ones, I’m here to support you every step of the way.

I’m passionate about helping newcomers build a successful future in Canada and committed to providing honest, reliable, and professional immigration services.

about_me_txt:
I am a multilingual Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). With over 15 years of experience supporting newcomers to Canada, I bring a deep and nuanced understanding of immigration law, refugee resettlement, sponsorship programs, and pathways to permanent residency and citizenship.
My expertise includes temporary permits, skilled worker applications, refugee claims, and appeals. I’m known for meticulous case preparation, strategic advocacy, and a compassionate approach—consistently guiding individuals and families through complex immigration processes with accuracy and care.
I hold a Bachelor of Laws from Carleton University and a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen's University. I stay current with immigration policies and legal developments to ensure my clients receive informed, effective solutions tailored to their unique needs.
Beyond my immigration practice, I have led policy development, stakeholder engagement, and program implementation across government and community sectors.
I’ve been recognized for my commitment to human rights and social justice, receiving the Roberto Miranda Award from the University of Ottawa’s Canadian Association of Refugee Lawyers (CARL) chapter.
Fluent in English, French, Amharic, and Tigrinya, I’m dedicated to helping clients navigate the immigration system with clarity and confidence.

advisor_data.bio:
As an immigrant myself, I bring a personal understanding of the challenges, emotions, and hopes that come with starting a new chapter in a new country. My own journey inspired me to become a RCIC, so I can support others with the compassion, insight, and professionalism that this life-changing process deserves.

Long before becoming certified, I had already been helping family members and close friends navigate immigration forms and documentation. Those early, unofficial experiences made me realize how overwhelming the process can be—and how valuable it is to have someone knowledgeable and trustworthy by your side.

Fluent in Arabic, Dari and an understanding of Urdu, I can effectively communicate with clients from a wide range of backgrounds, ensuring they feel heard, understood, and confident throughout their immigration journey.

about_me_txt:
Like many others in Canada, I immigrated here at an early age and completed my post-secondary education as an international student. The transition wasn’t easy — shifting from a comfortable, parent-supported life to juggling work, full-time studies, and the pressure of building a career brought significant challenges. I deeply relate to others facing similar struggles, which is why I chose to join this industry: to help make that transition smoother and more accessible for others navigating the same path.

Immigration policies are constantly evolving, making it essential for professionals to stay informed and carefully navigate each step of the process to ensure successful outcomes. I recognize how important and sensitive this phase is in an individual’s life, and I am committed to delivering guidance and support with the utmost care, professionalism, and dedication.

about_me_txt:
My name is Bhavan Kaur, and I am a dedicated immigration professional and Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). I am also a partner at Karvaan Immigration & Visa Services, a firm committed to delivering strategic and client-focused immigration solutions. Since entering the immigration field in October 2024, our team has developed a strong reputation for excellence across a broad range of application types, including study permits, work permits, visitor visas, family sponsorships, and permanent residency pathways such as Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs).
In addition to my work in immigration, I bring over eight years of experience in technical writing within the corporate sector. This background enables me to effectively support clients with technical or professional profiles, offering tailored guidance for entrepreneurs, skilled workers, and international students.
I hold a post-graduate credential in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University in Kingston. I remain committed to ethical practice, dependable service, and building trusted partnerships to help individuals and families navigate the complexities of Canada’s immigration system with confidence.

about_me_txt:
I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and co-founder of Pars Nova Immigration Services Inc., based in Vancouver, British Columbia. My path to immigration consulting was shaped by years of working closely with students and newcomers, witnessing their dreams, challenges, and resilience. These experiences sparked a deep desire to offer professional guidance to those navigating the complex journey of starting a new life in Canada.
My academic background includes a Master’s degree in French Literature, and I have been teaching French since 2006. Through education, I learned the importance of clear communication, patience, and advocacy—qualities that now define my approach as an immigration consultant. I believe in listening closely to each client’s story, understanding their goals, and offering tailored, honest advice that empowers them to move forward with confidence.
As an RCIC-IRB, I bring both regulatory knowledge and personal insight to every case. I remain committed to continuous learning, staying informed of changes in Canadian immigration law to ensure the people I work with receive accurate, up-to-date support. I work fluently in English, French, and Farsi, and I’m proud to serve a diverse community both in Canada and internationally.
Helping people find their place in Canada isn’t just my profession—it’s a calling I care deeply about.

about_me_txt:
Ghazal Dara is a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). She is the founder and CEO of Dara Immigration Services, a Canadian immigration consultancy built on the core values of trust, transparency, and personalized care. Ghazal brings a wealth of knowledge, compassion, and professionalism to every client she serves.

Originally from Iran, Ghazal’s journey to Canada was both personal and transformative. Fluent in Farsi and deeply connected to her cultural roots, she understands firsthand the challenges and hopes that come with starting life in a new country. Her own immigration experience sparked a lifelong passion for helping others navigate the Canadian immigration system with clarity and confidence.

Ghazal pursued her post-secondary education in Canada, earning a Bachelor of Science degree in Biological Sciences from Simon Fraser University. She also obtained a post-graduate degree in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University. Her academic background, combined with practical experience and training in Canadian immigration, gives her a unique ability to analyze complex cases and provide strategic, client-focused solutions.

At Dara Immigration Services, Ghazal offers a full range of immigration services, including but not limited to Study Permits, LMIA-Based and LMIA-Exempt Work Permits, Visitor Visas, Family Sponsorships, Express Entry Applications, Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), and Start-Up Visas. Ghazal takes pride in offering comprehensive support tailored to the unique needs of each client. Whether advising international students, skilled professionals, entrepreneurs or families seeking reunification, she works with a firm commitment to ethical service, ensuring that her clients are fully informed and empowered throughout the process. Her clients often commend her for her clear communication, responsiveness, and the sense of assurance she brings to even the most complex applications.

At Dara Immigration Services, Ghazal’s mission is simple: to empower clients by making the Canadian immigration process more accessible and understandable. With a deep respect for each client’s background and goals, she builds meaningful relationships rooted in trust.

Ghazal continues to grow her practice with integrity and purpose, helping people from all walks of life begin their Canadian journey with confidence.

about_me_txt:
My journey with Canadian immigration law began in 2018, when I immigrated to Canada from India with my family. Navigating the complexities of the permanent residence process firsthand inspired me to pursue a career in immigration consulting and ultimately become a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB).

I hold a Master’s degree in English Literature and Cultural Studies from Panjab University. After settling in Edmonton, Alberta, I worked as an ESL instructor and also tutored children privately. These experiences deepened my understanding of the challenges faced by newcomers and temporary residents, particularly in navigating language barriers and adapting to a new cultural environment.

Motivated by these experiences, I enrolled in the Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law program at Queen’s University in 2023. Upon completing the program and passing the licensing examination, I became a licensed RCIC-IRB and established Maiva Immigration Services Inc. in Edmonton.

At Maiva Immigration Services Inc., I am committed to offering personalized, professional guidance to individuals and families navigating the Canadian immigration system. My practice covers a wide range of immigration services such as: Study Permits, Post Graduate Work Permit, Super Visa, Visitor Visa, Visitor Record, Express Entry Programs, Electronic Travel Authorization, Family and Spousal Sponsorship and Canadian Citizenship.

With a strong foundation in both education and lived experience, I aim to provide empathetic, informed support to help clients achieve their immigration goals with confidence.

about_me_txt:
My name is Yuliya Shevchenko. I work as an employed RCIC-IRB for a Calgary-based immigration firm.

I realized quite early in life that I was not driven by money or success as most people view it today. This pushed me to explore different careers, countries, and companies. All I needed was the purpose. I just couldn't see myself doing something without a clear vision WHY I was doing it and HOW it helped people.

When I moved to Canada and just started my quite carefree and exciting life there, the war in my home country paralyzed me without any option of continuing what I was doing before. Then and there I realized that my purpose was showing itself in all its inexplicable glory. That's how I decided to become an immigration specialist and help people all over the world to start their new lives in this amazing country.

That is how I graduated from Queen's University with a Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law in 2024 and started working as a Licensed Consultant.

During all the years of my big search, I was lucky to have traveled to 40 countries, to have lived in 3, and to have learned 4 languages (Swedish being the most random one). I love the mountains and feel blessed to live where they are so close and available for a hike any time of the year. I enjoy doing hot yoga and will always dance where there is music. I don't like pushy people but would always go extra mile for a nice genuine person.

about_me_txt:
I’m a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) with a deep commitment to helping people build their futures in Canada. I hold a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University, where I had the honour of graduating as valedictorian of my cohort. Before that, I earned my law degree in Poland, where I practiced for several years, which gave me a strong foundation in legal reasoning and a sharp eye for detail - skills I now bring into every case I handle.

My journey in immigration began long before I officially entered the profession. Over the years, I’ve worked in several immigration law firms across Canada, gaining hands-on experience with a wide range of immigration matters, from study permits and work visas to various permanent residency streams. I’ve come to truly appreciate that no two applications are alike, and I take pride in tailoring my approach to the unique needs and stories of every client.

I genuinely enjoy solving complex problems and helping people find clarity in what can often feel like a confusing process. Whether I’m supporting students, professionals, or families, my goal is always the same: to make their immigration journey as smooth and empowering as possible.

Outside of work, you’ll often find me exploring BC’s beautiful trails, getting lost in a good book, or spending time with friends - old and new.

about_me_txt:
My name is Margi Patel, and I am a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), license number R731166. I have been licensed since October 2023 and have experience working on a variety of immigration applications, including visitor visas, super visas, Express Entry, and more.

As an immigrant to Canada myself at a young age, I truly understand the emotional and practical challenges that come with the immigration journey. That personal experience is what drives me to help others navigate the process with care, honesty, and professionalism. My goal is to support individuals and families through every step of their immigration path, making it as smooth and stress-free as possible.

I hold a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen’s University and a Bachelor’s degree from the University of Manitoba. My academic background, along with real-world experience, has equipped me with the knowledge and skills needed to guide clients with confidence and integrity.

I offer services in English, Hindi, and Gujarati, so I can assist a wide range of clients in a language they are most comfortable with. Whether you are applying to visit Canada, sponsor a family member, or explore permanent residency options, I’m here to help to assist you with your immigration needs.

about_me_txt:
Jagdev Singh, MSc, MBA, RCIC (License No. R707336) is the visionary founder of Canossom Immigration Consulting Inc. , a Mississauga, Canada-based global immigration and career guidance firm. With over two decades of combined experience across education, career coaching, and immigration advisory, Jagdev has built a reputation as a trusted expert for individuals, professionals, and entrepreneurs pursuing life-changing moves abroad.

Qualifications & Credentials
Jagdev boasts a rich tapestry of academic credentials and certifications spanning multiple domains:
Postgraduate Diploma in Computing , University of Ballarat (Australia) Diplomas : Architectural Engineering; Industrial Psychology Master’s Degrees : Psychotherapy & Counselling; Business Administration (Human Resource Management) Honors Diploma in Immigration Consulting (Canada)
Moreover, he holds a profusion of international coaching credentials:
Certified Career Coach (USA) Certified Career Analysis (CCA, UK) Certified Career Counselling for International Studies (CCCIS) Certified REBT, Mindfulness & Professional Life Coach (USA) Certified CBT Coach (USA)
As a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant , he holds License No. R707336 under the regulatory body CICC.

Philosophy & Client-Centric Approach
Jagdev champions:
Integrity : Providing facts and being upfront about eligibility and timelines . Empowerment through Knowledge : Offering clarity around visa policies, application steps, and success factors. Holistic Coaching : Merging immigration advisory with career and life coaching ensures clients are prepared professionally and personally.

Service Portfolio
Canossom’s service offerings reflect a holistic, end-to-end model tailored to diverse client needs:
Study Pathways : expert profiling and guidance for international students pursuing education abroad Skilled and Business Immigration : multi-country strategic planning and application for Canada, Australia, UK, USA, New Zealand, and more . Work & Job Seeker Permits : support for LMIA-based and LMIA-exempt work visa processes designed for skill-based migration . Visitor & Family Visas : spousal, family, marriage, and tourist visas with an emphasis on reunification and mobility . Investor & Business Immigration : includes Startup Visa advisory, investment pathways, and business set-up assistance . Refused Applications : strategic appeal and reapplication support post-rejection . Career Counseling & Resume Services : psychometric-led career assessments, coaching, and resume optimization

Whether you are a student plotting a study-abroad path, a skilled tradesperson seeking fair recognition, a business leader exploring expansion, or a family eager to reunite across borders, as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant I stand ready to chart your course. Book a complimentary discovery call, experience his consultative depth first-hand, and take the next decisive step toward the life you envision.
“Immigration is not merely a change of address; it is the launching pad for your greatest potential. Let’s co-create that journey, one informed decision at a time.” — Jagdev Singh.

The Canossom Journey: 3 Core Steps
Initial Consultation : Understand client goals, review qualifications, and analyze viable pathways. Personalized Strategy : Design a plan—whether for PR, study, work, or business. Prepare and submit applications. Guided Execution : Manage everything from paperwork and interviews to appeals, ensuring smooth progress and transparency .

about_me_txt: As an immigrant from Pakistan, I personally experienced the emotional and logistical challenges of navigating Canada’s immigration system. That journey inspired me to help others facing similar uncertainty. Recognizing the growing need for trusted, licensed professionals in this space, I founded WQA Immigration Services to offer reliable, client-focused immigration guidance. We assist with a broad range of immigration pathways, including Express Entry, PNP, LMIA, Work Permits, Spousal and Visitor Visas, and Business Immigration. As a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and a graduate of Queen’s University’s Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law, I combine legal expertise with a solid foundation in research analysis to stay informed on evolving immigration policies. At WQA Immigration Services, I am committed to supporting individuals and families through every stage of their immigration journey because immigration isn’t just about moving countries, it’s about building a better future.

about_me_txt:
Nodira is a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant – IRB and a Commissioner for Oaths in and for the Province of Alberta. Born and raised in Tajikistan, Nodira obtained her Law degree at the Tajik State University of Law, Business, & Politics in 1999. By 2002 Nodira immigrated to Canada along with her family, where later in 2008, she completed the Professional Legal Assistant program at CDI College in Calgary, Alberta. In 2022, Nodira obtained a Graduate Diploma from the Immigration and Citizenship Law program at Queen’s University.

Prior to becoming an immigration consultant; Nodira first worked at a boutique law firm, where she specialized in residential real estate transactions. From 2013 onward, she worked for one of the top litigation law firms in Calgary where she developed a wide range of skills specializing in research, document preparation and management.
During her study in the GDipICL program at Queen’s University, Nodira gained the required knowledge and professional skills needed for working in the immigration law field. She has a deep understanding of Canadian immigration and citizenship law and procedures, as well as the knowledge and skills necessary for successful practice.
With her extensive experience in the legal industry, you can trust Nodira with your immigration journey to Canada.

about_me_txt:
Sheeba Joseph is a dedicated Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC-IRB) and an active member in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). She holds a valid license to practice as an Authorized Representative under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (Canada) and the Citizenship Act (Canada) and their corresponding Government Regulations. Additionally, she is a Commissioner of Oaths (Ontario) and a registered member of the Canadian Association of Professional Immigration Consultants (CAPIC).
Sheeba Joseph has completed her Canadian Immigration studies from Queens University, Canada and also holds a master’s degree in business administration. Sheeba has a background in Human Resources and Consulting for the financial services and manufacturing Industries. She is fully dedicated to offering advisory services that empower clients to make well-informed decisions regarding their Canadian immigration pathways. With her professional expertise and industry knowledge, Sheeba Joseph possesses the ability to navigate the intricacies of the immigration system with confidence, ensuring that clients receive accurate and up-to-date information. At Zane Immigration Inc., led by Sheeba Joseph, the utmost commitment is placed on providing exceptional guidance and support to individuals and families seeking to relocate to Canada.
Being a trusted RCIC-IRB, Sheeba Joseph is fully equipped to provide the expertise and support necessary for successfully maneuvering through the complexities of Canada’s immigration system. Whether you are an individual seeking to immigrate for employment purposes, reunite with family members, or pursue educational opportunities, our regulated immigration consultant is ready to guide you throughout your immigration journey, leading you towards a brighter future in Canada.

about_me_txt:
I am Mona Bakhtiari, a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) holding a Graduate Diploma in Immigration and Citizenship Law from Queen's University. My journey in the immigration field has been characterized by an unwavering commitment to my clients. My profound understanding of immigration regulations and laws equips me to navigate the complexities of the Canadian immigration system effectively. My academic foundation empowers me to provide clients with the guidance they need. In addition to my legal expertise, I bring a diverse background as an ESL Teacher and Educator, enhancing my practice with a wealth of empathy and cultural understanding. This unique perspective allows me to connect with clients from various backgrounds, making their immigration journey smoother and more reassuring.

My passion lies in helping clients achieve their goals, whether it's obtaining visas, study permits, permanent residency, or citizenship. I ensure personalized support and clarity for each client, resulting in a seamless transition to their new life in Canada. Furthermore, I hold a Master's degree in Cell and Molecular Biology from Iran and Germany, along with a Bachelor's degree in Language Interpretation and Translation from Iran. I am fluent in both English and Farsi (Persian). My academic achievements and language proficiency contribute to my ability to serve clients effectively and comprehensively.
